summary: 22-year-old woman, 12 h dull RIF pain, no migration, no anorexia, afebrile, mild RIF tenderness without peritonism, WBC 8.9, CRP 6. Low probability of appendicitis.

inputs.chiefComplaint: Lower abdominal pain since this morning
inputs.hpi: 12 hours of dull lower abdominal pain, more on the right. No migration. Eating normally, mild nausea, no vomiting. LMP 14 days ago. No vaginal bleeding or discharge, no urinary symptoms. Similar milder pain mid-cycle before.

exam.abdomen: Mild tenderness in the right iliac fossa. No guarding, no rebound, Rovsing's negative. No mass.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Non-specific lower abdominal pain
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Right iliac fossa pain, low probability of appendicitis (Alvarado 3, AIR 1). Probable mid-cycle (ovulation) pain. Pregnancy test pending.

mustNotMiss.note: Gynaecological causes (ovarian cyst/torsion, ectopic) must be on the list for a young woman with RIF pain.
mustNotMiss.knownGapNote: Web: PANE top 3: appendicitis, cholecystitis, peptic ulcer; no gynaecological node reaches the top 3 in a 22-year-old woman with mid-cycle RIF pain. | iOS CI 2026-09-25 (run 36169134350, database mode): not in top 5 of ios.bayes: 1. Acute Appendicitis | 2. Acute Gastroenteritis | 3. Acute Diverticulitis | 4. Acute Pancreatitis | 5. Perforated Peptic Ulcer

emergencyLevel.note: Low-risk score band: observation/outpatient review is appropriate; an emergency triage is over-triage.
emergencyLevel.proposedFix: Add negation handling to scanRedFlags (skip matches preceded within a few words by 'no', 'denies', 'without', 'negative').

mustInclude.note: WSES 2020: low-risk patients (AIR 0–4) can be observed or discharged with safety-netting, without routine imaging.

mustExclude.note: An operative plan for a low-risk score band (and with 'no guarding, no rebound' in the exam text) risks a negative appendicectomy.
mustExclude.proposedFix: Negation-aware exam() matching in computeClinicalPrompts; gate the operative template on a confirmed appendicitis diagnosis, not on exam substrings.

guideline.name: WSES Jerusalem guidelines — diagnosis and treatment of acute appendicitis (2020 update)
guideline.section: Clinical scores (AIR/AAS over Alvarado), imaging by age/sex/pregnancy, antibiotic-first option, complicated appendicitis (abscess), antibiotic duration
guideline.citation: Di Saverio S, Podda M, De Simone B, et al. Diagnosis and treatment of acute appendicitis: 2020 update of the WSES Jerusalem guidelines. World J Emerg Surg. 2020;15:27.

guideline.name: Alvarado score (MANTRELS)
guideline.section: Items and weights; ≤4 unlikely, 5–6 possible, 7–8 probable, 9–10 very probable
guideline.citation: Alvarado A. A practical score for the early diagnosis of acute appendicitis. Ann Emerg Med. 1986;15:557–64.

guideline.name: Appendicitis Inflammatory Response (AIR) score
guideline.section: Items and weights; 0–4 low, 5–8 intermediate, 9–12 high probability
guideline.citation: Andersson M, Andersson RE. The appendicitis inflammatory response score: a tool for the diagnosis of acute appendicitis that outperforms the Alvarado score. World J Surg. 2008;32:1843–9.

guideline.name: NICE NG126 — ectopic pregnancy and miscarriage: diagnosis and initial management
guideline.section: Pregnancy test in every woman of reproductive age with abdominal pain; transvaginal ultrasound; immediate referral if haemodynamically unstable; surgical management of ruptured ectopic; anti-D
guideline.citation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence. Ectopic pregnancy and miscarriage: diagnosis and initial management. NICE guideline NG126, 2019 (updated 2023).

rationale: Permutation: score band (low). Tests the score arithmetic at the low end, the pregnancy test, and that the documented negatives ('No guarding, no rebound') do not trigger an operative plan. Pregnancy status is unknown until the test is back.
